# STATUS

**GENERATED — do not edit.** Produced by `tools/tests/verify_all.py`. If a number here looks wrong,
the fix is in the code that produces it, never in this file.

A hand-written status page is true on the day it is written and silently false afterwards. This one
is regenerated by the same run that checks it, which is why its counts cannot drift — the reason Z4
exists in `HEAL.md`.

---

## What is verified

| check | what it establishes | where |
|---|---|---|
| Gate controls | the method answers correctly on every case we have thought of, in both directions | `tools/tests/test_validator.py` |
| Adversarial probe hunt | the method answers correctly on cases we have **not** thought of — the hunt tries to make it wrong | `tools/tests/probe_hunt.py` |
| Fixture controls | the known-bad files are still refused with **exit 1**, and a missing file still errors with **exit 3** | `tools/tests/make_fixtures.py` |
| Self-audit | this repository passes its own gate | `.github/workflows/controls.yml` |
| Artifact freshness | every generated artifact matches a fresh generation | `REGISTER.md`, `REGISTER.html` |
| Heal register | no blocking defect is left open | `HEAL.md` |
| Leak scan | no secrets and no absolute home paths in tracked files | — |

Run it yourself:

```bash
python3 tools/tests/verify_all.py     # exit 0 = clean
```

---

## What this does NOT claim

- That any test **passes**. A `tests/` directory is presence, not correctness.
- That any workflow is **meaningful**. The gate proves a job *can* fail; it does not prove the job
  tests anything worth testing.
- That any code is **correct, secure, or used**.
- Anything about parties outside this account. **The only claim that grants authority is an external
  party depending on, citing, or routing through an artifact.**

---

## Provenance

Method: `tools/validate_workflows.py` — identified by content hash in `REGISTER.md`, never by a
hand-maintained version string. A version number is another claim that can drift from the artifact
it describes.

Every defect this project has found is recorded in `INCIDENTS.md` with the control it produced, and
the current disposition of every known gap is in `HEAL.md`.
